permittedTransformations.rule: Quote style, trailing commas, and insignificant whitespace may differ after TypeScript printer normalization.
Adapted suites import Octane sources and @octanejs/testing-library; pristine suites import relative React upstream modules and @testing-library/react.
Component test files may use .tsrx instead of .tsx; a few utilities move under components/{group,panel}/.
expect(node).toHaveAttribute(name, value) maps to expect(node.getAttribute(name)).toBe(value); bare toHaveAttribute(name) maps to hasAttribute(name)).toBe(true).
Layout-effect invariant failures observed via React RTL toThrow map to captureLayoutEffectError(...).toBe(true) because Octane reports those exceptions through console.error.
React Profiler render-count expects collapse to the Panel-children re-render invariant Octane can observe without Profiler.
Numeric style zero may serialize as '0' (React/jsdom) or '0px' (Octane CSSOM normalization) for minHeight/minWidth.
React's mocked ':r123:' fallback becomes a non-empty Octane useId string.
